title: Quartzcraft
description: The official minecraft roleplay server for the Empire of Valdoria.
body:
Quartzcraft is a **mock-government**, **roleplay** minecraft server, largely focused on the ‘Empire of Valdoria’.
We have highly-flexible player-driven lore, and are open to people of all backgrounds and interests to join and help build up the lore.

🏛️ You can participate in governance, shaping laws and policies for the people, or to benefit yourself.

🏭 Become a merchant, and dominate the markets by building factories, thanks to the Create mod.

📜 Or maybe you just want to help shape lore? Quartzcraft is always looking for worldbuilders and dedicated roleplayers.

Quartzcraft strongly encourages player cooperation, ambitious projects, roleplay, and most of all: worldbuilding.

Interested? Join the discord server, and you can get started!
